summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim consolidated financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026, approved by the board on August 7, 2026. The filing reports operating revenue of NT$121.35 billion, net profit attributable to owners of parent of NT$20.75 billion, and basic EPS of NT$2.68. This is a routine periodic financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is announced, so the filing does not involve any deal terms or special-situation categorization.
